2546.title: bb plugin new scaffolds a plugin that cannot import @get-bb/plugin-sdk/testing: cron-parser is undeclared
2546.rootCauseOneLine: The backend test harness imports cron-parser, but the scaffold omits this optional SDK peer, so Node fails during module load.

prReviews.topFinding: Its cron-parser fix is correct, but npmFailureDetail can discard all stderr when stdout has more than eight lines.

2546.proposedFix: Add cron-parser to scaffold development dependencies. Add a manifest contract test that reads peerDependenciesMeta. Fix PR #2550 to retain separate stderr and stdout tails.
2546.caveats: The base SDK version 0.4.24 was unavailable on npm, so the repro used a local archive from the exact base commit. The host used Node 24 and npm 11, but the failure matched the Node 20 and npm 10 report. The revision adds the local Vitest configuration that the verifier needed. No app server was necessary.

2540.title: GitHub plugin silently discards extraRepos entries that are not owner/repo
2540.rootCauseOneLine: The GitHub plugin accepts free-form extraRepos text, then a one-branch regular expression filter drops each invalid entry without a diagnostic.

prReviews.topFinding: The patch repeats the same warning after each forced discovery, and the repository-list command still gives no direct diagnostic.
The patch reports invalid entries on standard error and once in logs, preserves standard output, updates documentation, and passed all 30 tests.

2540.proposedFix: Parse extraRepos into valid and invalid lists. Keep valid names, report invalid names on standard error, warn once per distinct invalid set, and document that wildcards do not work.
2540.caveats: The source-level harness reproduced the CLI and log path. It did not test the real settings route, desktop 0.39.0, or a browser. The GitHub API returned UNKNOWN mergeability, but both local merge-tree checks passed.

2537.title: Ask-User-Question needs some love on mobile
2537.rootCauseOneLine: The plugin uses a fixed viewport height and intrinsic host widths, so the sticky footer clips its top and right edges.
2537.proposedFix: Make the host measure and constrain each plugin card. Add min-w-0 to the grid child. Use display: contents for the host fieldset.
2537.caveats: I used Chrome mobile emulation and Cursor. I did not use a real iPhone, Brave, its software keyboard, or Pi 0.84.2.

2533.title: Desktop cold start can leave the shell on a terminal "Failed to load projects." until an unrelated realtime event refetches
2533.rootCauseOneLine: The sidebar bootstrap exhausts a narrow retry policy after the socket's one-time repair check, so no later lifecycle trigger refetches it.
2533.proposedFix: Add a sidebar-specific policy for transport, 408, 429, and 5xx errors. Use capped backoff, low-rate recovery, and a Retry button.
2533.caveats: The deterministic Linux browser test reproduced the defect. I did not test the natural macOS cold-start timing or the reporter's large database.

2519.title: Plugin file openers built before `experimental_hostId` fail with "rpc input validation failed" when opening a file from a draft thread
2519.rootCauseOneLine: BB adds experimental_hostId to every environment-free project source, and old strict opener contracts reject that unknown RPC field.
2519.proposedFix: Add an explicit capability for environment-free project sources. Default it to false, and use the native preview for old openers.
2519.caveats: The exact external plugin source was unavailable. The live app and server test used the strict pre-field schema stated in the issue. The host inode pool blocked a fresh dependency tree, so the revision reused the completed initial-checkout dependencies.

2508.title: submit-a-plugin skill: engines example doesn't match get-bb/marketplace entry schema
2508.rootCauseOneLine: Commit 1e56238f removed marketplace engines fields but did not update the built-in skill or add schema-parity coverage.
2508.proposedFix: Remove engines from the skill prose and example. State that package.json owns compatibility. Add a test that validates the example against the schema.
2508.caveats: The isolated pnpm install reached the shared inode limit. The prepared dependency tree supported a successful Turbo build. Four reported submission failures remain unverified.
